MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 18

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 32
   C. 9
   D. 64

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

8. Solve for x: x + 9 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 10
   C. 19
   D. 9

9. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

11. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

12. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 49
   D. 41

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

15. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 10

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

18. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

19. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

20. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

21. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 1

22. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 25

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 33
   D. 28

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 31

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
